hypothesis: A front-visible obstacle inserted after an EGO spline is active will be observed by the single-D435i map, cause a different EGO traj_id for the same goal/epoch, and be followed by PX4/bridge until goal completion.
single_scenario_variable: Insert one static visible box at a fixed world pose 12.0 simulation seconds after the first spline for the active goal.

injection.trigger: NavigationCommand.target.header.stamp plus 12.0 simulated seconds; the first same-goal B-spline must already have been observed

success_observations: run identity matches the frozen runtime and the initial goal/spline are observed
same goal_id and epoch publish a different EGO traj_id after injection
PX4/bridge show execution following the replacement path and the original position/yaw dwell completes
zero prohibited contacts and terminal observation coverage from planner, bridge, truth and contact observers
independent final readback is landed, disarmed, control disabled and zero control before stopping the project container

diagnostic_abort.action: caller-cancel through the existing mission path; bridge-owned landing; preserve the run as failed/partial
